subject: Pop-up 'Redwood Garden' — merchandise exclusivity, demo trailer, and weather contingency
messages:
From: Samira Khan <samira@festivalco.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: FestivalCo Sponsorship Ops <sponsorship@festivalco.com>
Date: Mon, 28 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Redwood Garden — outdoor demo footprint and merch exclusivity inquiry

Hi Mina,

Excited to have Redwood potentially anchor our new open-air activation area — we call it the Festival Garden. A few items we want to clarify before we finalize the package:

- Merch exclusivity: Redwood asked about exclusive rights to sell branded apparel and drinkware in the Garden. Is that something we can offer across the footprint?
- Demo trailer: you requested a 20'x10' trailer plug-and-play spot. We need specifications for power, staging, and ingress/egress timing.
- Weather contingency: the Garden is outdoors; storms in past years caused multiple vendor relocations. Do you require an elevated platform or canopy?

Attaching: site_map.pdf for current Garden layout.

If you can share a short list of must-haves and must-not-haves, we can draft a tailored SOW and a DocuSign ready agreement.

Best,
Samira
Samira Khan
Sr. Sponsorship Manager, FestivalCo
attachments: site_map.pdf

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samira Khan <samira@festivalco.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 28 Sep 2026 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood Garden — outdoor demo footprint and merch exclusivity inquiry

Hi Samira — thanks for the site map, good context. High level from our side:

- Merch exclusivity: Redwood is interested in exclusivity for branded apparel (tees, hoodies) and drinkware (reusable bottles, insulated tumblers) within the Garden footprint only. We are not asking for festival-wide exclusivity.
- Minimum guarantee: we can agree to exclusivity if FestivalCo guarantees a minimum sales placement and a shelf/merch table directly adjacent to our demo trailer.
- Trailer / footprint: the trailer is 20x10 (we'll provide exact mounting points). Power: 1x 20A 240V dedicated circuit for climate control + 1x 20A 120V dedicated for demo rig. On-site drop-off window required between 0700–0900 on load-in day.
- Weather ops: we require a 10'x20' canopy over demo entrance and a raised platform (6" min) for trailer access if there is standing water risk. We also need a fallback indoor location within 30 minutes of the Garden in case of sustained storm.
- Insurance / COI: we'll need FestivalCo to include Redwood as additional insured with $2M general liability and confirmation of vendor COI process.

I've attached our proposed merch SKUs and a short SOW ask list in proposed-merch-skus.xlsx. Happy to hop on a call to walk through.

Thanks,
Mina Haddad
Partner Marketing Lead, Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference | mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com
attachments: proposed-merch-skus.xlsx

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 30 Sep 2026 08:13:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Redwood Garden — exclusivity and ops (internal)

Marissa / Karthik / Aditya — forwarding Samira's note and our reply. Key negotiation points:

1) Merch exclusivity (Garden-only) — trade: exclusivity in exchange for a $12k minimum guarantee + premium placement (table + two branded islands). Marissa, can we accept $12k guarantee or do you want units sold guarantee instead?
2) Trailer power / load-in windows — logistics fine but need to confirm rig testing access day before event (we'll want a 2-hour run).
3) Weather fallback — insist on indoor fallback within 30 minutes or a contractual relocation fee waived if customer moves us; otherwise we provide plan B canopy at our cost but that weakens expectation of festival support.
4) VIP inventory & speaking slot — we should try to secure a 20-min demo slot on the acoustic stage adjacent to the Garden (no heavy amplification), plus 6 VIP passes and 2 backstage/tech passes.

Quick asks:
- Marissa: pricing/concessions guidance (is $12k guarantee acceptable under current ARR target for this partnership bucket?)
- Karthik: anything on compliance/insurance side I should flag?
- Aditya: ops note — confirm trailer power requirement is okay for staging vendor; I'll loop Jake at EventLogistics.

Thanks,
Mina

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 1 Oct 2026 10:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Redwood Garden — exclusivity and ops (internal)

Got it — thanks for the summary, Mina. My read: accept exclusivity for the Garden only with the $12k minimum guarantee OR a minimum sell-through threshold of 400 units across weekend (whichever is higher). Rationale: reduces our inventory risk but keeps us competitive on price.

Other concessions:
- We'll take the 20-min demo slot if it's acoustic/low-amp — good product storytelling opportunity.
- Ask for the indoor fallback clause and a commitment for a vendor relocation fee waiver (FestivalCo covers cost to move us indoors).
- Merch placement: insist on a fixed 6ft branded merch island + 2 pop-up racks within 10' of trailer entrance.

Karthik, please confirm insurance language: we can accept being added as additional insured at $2M, but we need a reciprocating hold-harmless clause for our demo equipment. Also request festival provide COI naming Redwood and our trailer vendor (EventLogistics).

Mina: if FestivalCo agrees to all above, sign SOW and proceed to DocuSign — keep $ for sponsorship bucket, but mark as partner-led acquisition.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Events Manager, Redwood Inference

From: Samira Khan <samira@festivalco.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Jake Porter <jake.porter@eventlogistics.io>, FestivalCo Sponsorship Ops <sponsorship@festivalco.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 16:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood Garden — merchandise exclusivity, demo trailer, and weather contingency

Mina — happy to confirm we can incorporate Redwood's asks with a few edits to the SOW. Summary of what FestivalCo will commit to: 

- Garden-only merch exclusivity for apparel + drinkware, subject to a $12,000 minimum guarantee OR 400-unit sell-through (FestivalCo will track POS and report daily).
- Fixed 6ft merch island + two pop-up racks positioned within 10' of trailer entrance; final placement to be approved during site walk.
- 20x10 trailer spot approved; EventLogistics (cc'ed) will provide 20A 240V and 20A 120V drops. Jake: please confirm load-in window and tabletop testing slot on Oct 14 (day-before).
- Weather contingency: FestivalCo will provide indoor relocation within 30 minutes or cover relocation cost up to $5,000. If weather cancellation happens, Redwood may elect for full credit or move to next year's Garden with rollover credit.
- Insurance: we'll update the SOW to add Redwood as additional insured for $2M and include reciprocal hold-harmless language for your demo equipment.

I've attached SOW_draft_v4.pdf and a DocuSign link; please review and sign if acceptable. Looking forward to having Redwood in the Garden — excited about the demo trailer.

Best,
Samira
Samira Khan
Sr. Sponsorship Manager, FestivalCo
attachments: SOW_draft_v4.pdf
